sentences.japanese: 驚かない所をみると知ってたのね。
sentences.english: Seeing that you're not surprised, I think you must have known.
Where there's a will, there's a way.

sentences.japanese: 暗い所が怖いっていうのを乗り越える必要がありますね。
sentences.english: You must conquer your fear of the dark.

sentences.japanese: 君には何も悪い所はない。
sentences.english: There is nothing wrong with you.

sentences.japanese: 君にたたかれた腕の所がとても痛い。
sentences.english: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
